description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/Cookie_Troubleshooting_Log.xlsx. This is a systematic recipe debugging log for chocolate chip cookies with 6 baking attempts tracked. Attempts 1-3 have complete data, but attempts 4-6 have missing values (marked with '???' or blank). Fill in the missing data using the clues in the 'Notes' column. Then create a 'Variable Analysis' section below the main table to identify which variables (flour type, butter type, oven temp, etc.) correlate with failures. Add a 'Conclusions' section with your findings and a 'Recommendation for Attempt #7' section with specific, evidence-based suggestions for what to change. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
